notes: Approach judgement rebuilt: heights are above the runway, so hills no longer make an approach unstable.
Gear and landing flap are due at 500 ft; set between 900 and 500 ft is "configured late" (5 points, not 15).
Sim rate multiplies wear: wear rate x5 at sim rate x2 wears parts as x10 while it lasts.
Wear rates are typed in, 1 to 100, and settings are saved together instead of once per click.
The page reads its live figures every second; a failure set in Fenix's own EFB is in the tech log within 2 seconds.
